suites.name: match-room-phase-1-concurrency
assertions: PASS actual non-owner member sessions and explicit trusted-service session
PASS concurrent room creation yields exactly one fixed-membership room
PASS same sender and client key insert once across concurrent sessions
PASS conflicting payloads sharing a client key cannot overwrite the winning message
PASS two participants allocate distinct, contiguous room sequences
PASS twenty simultaneous sends respect the per-actor limit without blocking the other participant
PASS reading a displayed cursor while a new message arrives leaves the new message unread
PASS concurrent stale read requests never move the cursor backwards
PASS account closure waits for an in-flight send and then removes its direct actor attribution
PASS closure queued first denies the stale-session send and prevents read-state recreation
PASS rejected second migration application preserves schema, ACLs and every public/private table row

suites.name: match-room-phase-3-concurrency
assertions: PASS opposite senders serialize without actor-lock deadlock and create one episode each
PASS concurrent same-key retry creates one message and no new episode
PASS catchup-before-send resolves prior episode and creates exactly one successor
PASS send-before-partial-cursor preserves the existing unread episode
PASS both participants requesting help create one operational request
PASS recipient closure after send removes notifications and resolves recipient episode without deadlock
PASS recipient closure before send prevents stale-identity notifications without deadlock
PASS rejected migration reapplication preserves existing authority definitions
suites.summary: Passed 8 controlled Phase 3 PostgreSQL concurrency assertions.

suites.name: match-room-production-hardening-concurrency
assertions: PASS full forward migration defaults off and leaves every competitive/reset/closure authority body unchanged
PASS opposite senders retain serialized normal operation without busy errors
PASS same-key retries still create exactly one message
PASS real Not Held vs room resolution settles without deadlock and no partial room or partial closure
PASS all nine communication entry points fail55P03 atomically while tournament busy; same message key retries normally
PASS disable waits for admitted send; after disable completes no new message or alert can be admitted
PASS disable-first rejects a queued sender after the setting transaction commits
PASS disable serializes assistance creation and denies later requests/reopens
PASS real final-result deferred settlement and room read complete without reversed-order deadlock
PASS real RR reset and historical read retain generation privacy without extra authority locks
PASS send and existing account closure still serialize without notification or identity residue
PASS all real concurrency scenarios leave competitive/reset/closure function definitions unchanged
PASS reapplication fails atomically and preserves current flag and room definitions
